summary: This short note introduces Hassan Hanafi, born in 1935 in Cairo, Egypt. He is a professor who chairs the philosophy department at Cairo University and is regarded as a leading authority on modern Islam.
one_line: Hassan Hanafi, born 1935 in Cairo, chairs Cairo University's philosophy department and is a leading authority on modern Islam.
key_facts: Hassan Hanafi (حسن حنفی) was born in 1935 in Cairo, Egypt.
Hassan Hanafi chairs the philosophy department at Cairo University.
Hassan Hanafi is described as a leading authority on modern Islam.
